## 2ed2f53ebb44

**Reproduced teaching defect in the canonical demonstrations; generated labels themselves were not shown wrong.** All five canonical pairs have the identical 3×3 output `[[7,7,0],[7,7,0],[0,0,7]]`, so the rival “ignore the input and always emit that matrix” fits every canonical example exactly. The generator does emit lawful counterexamples, but it has no semantic rival/lesson contract guaranteeing that an assembled teaching lesson includes one.

The retained hard-band counterexample uses assigned generator SHA-256 `ae4440e917aa78fa55dbaca9db2bd28e7cbd3534f2753bd9ef6ba61e4ef9598d`, rule hash `f3d70027dbd4`, seed `424242`, and generated sample index `8`. It contains six documented-domain components, passes the target `self_check` with no errors, and the supported Racket `apply` command returns a valid 6×6 relation matrix rather than the constant 3×3 rival. Exact input, actual output, rival output, hashes, and commands are in `checks/audit/2ed2f53ebb44/counterexample.json`; the authority-bound application record is `checks/audit/2ed2f53ebb44/racket.json`. I left the audit target unchanged.

## 2ed2f53ebb44

**Reproduced unresolved constant-output teaching defect; audited target left
unchanged.** The pinned generator SHA-256 is
`ae4440e917aa78fa55dbaca9db2bd28e7cbd3534f2753bd9ef6ba61e4ef9598d`
and the executed canonical rule hash is `f3d70027dbd4`. This independently
confirms the prior lead `review-4cd35f21d087afc9:v0001` on the same source hash.

All four canonical demonstrations have the identical 3×3 output
`[[7,7,0],[7,7,0],[0,0,7]]`; the canonical held-out pair also has that output.
Thus “ignore the input and always emit that matrix” fits the canonical evidence.
The retained hard-band generated case (seed `424242`, sample index `8`) contains
six components, passes `self_check`, and the canonical Racket rule emits a
nonconstant 6×6 relation matrix, refuting the shortcut.

Fresh authority-bound evidence is in
`checks/audit/2ed2f53ebb44/counterexample.json`, with the exact input in
`checks/audit/2ed2f53ebb44/input.json`, application receipt in
`checks/audit/2ed2f53ebb44/racket.json`, and reproducible canonical-fit check in
`checks/audit/2ed2f53ebb44/reproduce.py`.

The generator can produce counterexamples, but it still has no executable
lesson-rival contract or schedule guarantee. This is a teaching defect rather
than a demonstrated label error.
